Furkan Bekdemir, MD. Psychiatry resident, Ondokuz Mayıs University Faculty of

## Position {.k-head}

**Resident physician and research assistant**, Department of Psychiatry,
Ondokuz Mayıs University.

## Research interests {.k-head}

Computational psychiatry; predictive processing and active inference; belief
updating and sensory attenuation; psychosis; instrumentation and measurement
for psychiatric research.
